members.name: flat_a
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does the message express? Pick the single most specific option.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a card they have received: how to activate it, or activation is not working.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open or use an account; whether children/teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or a phone/watch wallet, including topping up via Apple Pay or Google Pay.
criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs or which ATMs accept the card; whether the card can be used at ATMs (not fees, not declines).
criteria.automatic_top_up: The auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up or turn it off.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money coming IN to the customer's own account here by bank transfer (e.g. from their own UK/other bank account) is not showing up / balance has not changed or is taking long to update after a transfer, including 'how long does a transfer from my UK account take, I made one and it is not showing'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Deposited money, a cheque or cash but it is not showing / the balance has not updated; cheque slow to clear. Use this when the customer says they deposited money without naming a transfer.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a payee/beneficiary; beneficiary not allowed or rejected.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling or reversing a transfer or transaction they made (e.g. sent to the wrong account, want to undo it).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is about to expire or has expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; whether shops/merchants/places take the card.
criteria.card_arrival: The new card they ordered has not arrived yet; tracking the card in the post.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes; when the card will arrive; how will I get my card; whether it can arrive by a date; express delivery.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app/account; adding a card they received or an existing card into the app.
criteria.card_not_working: Card is not working in general: something is wrong with the card, it has not worked at several/multiple places, without a specific declined payment.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was added to a card payment or purchase; charged extra for paying with the card.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment on the account that they do not recognise or did not make.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong, incorrect or bad exchange rate applied to a payment/purchase (any wrong rate complaint that does not mention a cash withdrawal).
criteria.card_swallowed: The ATM kept / swallowed / retained the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees or charges for withdrawing cash at an ATM.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal (or cash showing in the app) that they did not make or do not recognise.
criteria.change_pin: Changing or resetting the card PIN to a new one; where/how the PIN can be changed (ATM, online, bank).
criteria.compromised_card: Worried the card details are compromised or someone else is using the card (fraud), without it being lost or stolen.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available in; using, opening the account or getting a card from a given country; which countries can get a card.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment or purchase was declined or rejected, or the card did not work when paying at a shop/restaurant/online.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined or not authorised; card won't work at an ATM / can't get money out.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or refused, or they are not allowed to make a transfer; also when the customer complains their 'transfers' keep being declined.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account that they do not recognise or did not set up.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits or restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many uses, how many can be made).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone, email, account details.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or charges for exchanging currency; extra cost of exchanging money.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, where to see exchange rates, how rates are set.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currency in the app; which currencies can be exchanged; converting money between currencies.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge or small amount (e.g. £1/$1) on the statement they cannot place; why was I charged.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer or a large payment (e.g. for a flat, mortgage, rent) failed, did not go through, or shows an error; transfer bounced back.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies the account can hold or receive; holding money in different currencies.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Getting or creating a disposable (single-use) virtual card; how disposable cards work, who can get them.
criteria.get_physical_card: Where to find or receive the card PIN (cannot find the PIN, PIN not received yet, how do I get a PIN). Not ordering a card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional / spare / second card, or a card for someone else on the account.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Getting or ordering a virtual card; where to find the virtual card; cost of virtual cards.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card was lost or stolen; how to report or freeze a lost/stolen card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone was lost, stolen or left behind; accessing the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card; how to get a plastic card; ordering a card abroad; whether cards can be shipped or mailed somewhere.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password; resetting the passcode to log in.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is still pending or has not gone through yet; why a payment is pending; when will my payment go through.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still pending, including when the ATM gave no cash but the withdrawal shows pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending/processing and has not completed.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer the customer explicitly says is pending / still in progress / not cleared, or complains a specific transfer is taking forever / so long, or money someone transferred to the customer is not visible yet.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many wrong attempts; account/card locked because of the PIN; unblocking it.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money or salary into the account; how someone can send them money; being paid.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund they expected has not appeared on the account/statement yet; still waiting for a refund.
criteria.request_refund: How to request or get a refund for something bought; asking for a refund.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment that went through was reverted/returned/cancelled and the money came back.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa/Mastercard/credit cards) and currencies are supported for top-up or payments.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up or depositing using cash or a cheque; how to do it.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up attempt did not work, failed or was declined.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum amount, how many top-ups, how much can be added.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up went through but was then reversed / the money disappeared.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up the account with a card; card top-up process.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Same payment charged twice; duplicate transaction.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for a transfer.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer or add money into the account; methods to fund the account from another account.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The customer sent money OUT (to a friend, family, landlord, retailer or another account, in the country or abroad) and it has not arrived / has not gone through yet even though the details were correct / the recipient did not get it.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take, or how much longer the customer has to wait for a transfer to arrive, when they do not say it is pending (e.g. 'it's been a couple of days, how much longer?').
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Trying to verify identity but it is not working or failing; cannot complete verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed for verification; how long verification takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or showing the source of funds; where their money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code or verification for a top-up or a top-up card; where to find the top-up verification code.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual or disposable virtual card is not working, or was declined/rejected when paying.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; wanting a Visa card or a Mastercard; choosing the card network.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is needed; why so much personal information is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash or less cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal at an ATM.
